{{Quote|But the Derra system is rumored to have a strong Rebel presence. I'll make sure to have some forces waiting there.|[[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], speaking of his plans which would result in the [[Battle of Derra IV]]|<ref name="Side Trip">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref>}}
The '''Derra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]], the site of the [[Battle of Derra IV]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], in which a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] convoy en route to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] was ambushed and destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.
